The '''Infinity Dagger''' is a [[Weapons#Dagger|dagger weapon]] that can be obtained by combining the {{Name|Galaxy Dagger|class=inline}} with {{Name|Galaxy Soul|3|class=inline}} and {{Name|Cinder Shard|60|class=inline}} in the [[Forge]].

Obtaining it unlocks the [[Achievements|Infinite Power]] achievement.
